provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.limitations: The program assumes the constructor's domain: a single bar of one colour on a background equal to palette[0], with the strip length taken from the full input extent along the bar axis. The generator rejects cases where the sequence would end with a lone wrapped cell, but the program would still render those consistently. No contradictions with the fixtures were found. None of this has been tested.
